strings.Der Host Summit ist der jährliche Branch: The Host Summit is the annual industry event of the Swiss short-term rental sector. Next date: Saturday, 30 October 2027. With a review of the first summit in Olten.

The Host Summit is the annual industry event of the Swiss short-term rental sector. It brings together hosts, property managers, technology providers, service providers, academia and politics, with market data, practical knowledge and networking. It is organised by the Swiss Short Term Rental Association.

strings.Der Schweizer Verband für Kurzzeitvermie: The Swiss Short Term Rental Association (SSTRA) was founded on 19 September 2026 in Olten. It connects hosts and property managers, sets standards and brings the industry's perspective into the debate on the rules for short-term rentals. The president is Reto Baumgartner.
